550:t_1:172.en:
$$マオ$$
「Being an officer is a pain. Having a private cabin just makes times like this more depressing.」

550:t_1:173.en:
$$宗介$$
「...$$クルツ$$'s last shot... was at a range of 1,650 meters...」

550:t_1:175.en:
$$宗介$$
「That incredible shot he poured his whole life into kept our future alive.」

550:t_1:176.en:
$$マオ$$
「He was himself right to the end...」

550:t_1:178.en:
$$マオ$$
「Did you hear about me and him?」

550:t_1:180.en:
$$マオ$$
「...Well, it just happened. It was a casual relationship, so you don't need to worry about me.」

550:t_1:181.en:
$$マオ$$
「We were just having fun. It wasn't some great romance. It was... like blowing off steam.」

550:t_1:182.en:
$$マオ$$
「I wasn't getting serious at my age. Things like this can happen, so I wanted to keep my distance anyway...」

550:t_1:184.en:
$$マオ$$
「I wasn't serious about him at all. He was six years younger than me, remember?」

550:t_1:185.en:
$$マオ$$
「That idiot... He was a womanizer and a show-off. I just played around with him a little. So...」

550:t_1:186.en:
$$宗介$$
(You don't have to say any more, $$マオ$$...)

550:t_1:188.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'm sorry... If I'd gotten $$テッサ$$ to safety then...」

550:t_1:190.en:
$$マオ$$
「Neither you nor $$テッサ$$ did anything wrong... He was an idiot... That's all...」

550:t_1:196.en:
$$マオ$$
「You... $$テッサ$$... everyone... I don't want to see anyone else I know die...」

550:t_1:198.en:
$$宗介$$
(...I've experienced the deaths of more comrades than I can count. I don't feel sorrow... I'm used to it...)

550:t_1:200.en:
$$宗介$$
(I think I've learned a little about how to smile, but I still don't know how to cry...)

550:t_1:201.en:
$$宗介$$
(Will the day ever come when an incomplete person like me can sob with trembling shoulders...?)

550:t_1:202.en:
$$宗介$$
(Why aren't you here, $$千鳥$$...? In your arms, maybe I could cry...)

550:t_1:206.en: ～$$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$　Hangar～

550:t_1:208.en:
$$サックス$$
「I tried forcing two $$ＸＬ－２$$ units together for the $$レーバテイン$$, but I've hit a brick wall!」

550:t_1:209.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「Shouldn't we give up, Boss?」

550:t_1:211.en:
$$ピニオン$$
「But we're out of time.」

550:t_1:212.en:
$$サックス$$
「I know that without you telling me!」

550:t_1:213.en:
$$アル$$
「Please, Lieutenant... This $$緊急展開ブースターＸＬ－３$$ is essential for the landing operation on $$メリダ島$$.」

550:t_1:214.en:
$$サックス$$
「That's right. Mounting this on you gives you flight capability for now and increases your firepower.」

550:t_1:215.en:
$$サックス$$
「And you can detach it whenever you want in battle... It's not bad equipment, is it?」

550:t_1:216.en:
$$アル$$
「In short, we can use it like the $$リ・ガズィ$$'s $$バック・ウェポン・システム$$.」

550:t_1:217.en:
$$サックス$$
「That's the blunt way of putting it.」

550:t_1:218.en:
$$アル$$
「The briefing will begin shortly, Lieutenant. Simply attaching the unit will suffice. I will attempt the adjustments myself.」

550:t_1:219.en:
$$サックス$$
「I'm a mechanic. I don't need to attend the landing operation briefing.」

550:t_1:220.en:
$$サックス$$
「And I have my own responsibilities. I'll finish it before the operation begins.」

550:t_1:222.en:
$$サックス$$
「I won't accept your proposal.」

550:t_1:223.en:
$$サックス$$
「The control software isn't the only problem. We may need to replace boards or parts, or even bypass wiring and pipes, depending on the cause.」

550:t_1:224.en:
$$サックス$$
「Your efforts won't fix that. You're a machine, so stay quiet like one.」

550:t_1:227.en:
$$アル$$
「No. May I ask a question?」

550:t_1:229.en:
$$アル$$
「Can you imagine having wings grow from your back?」

550:t_1:230.en:
$$サックス$$
「Hmm... Well... I may have imagined that as a kid.」

550:t_1:231.en:
$$アル$$
「If that is a rite of passage in human development, the problem may lie with me rather than the $$ＸＬ－３$$.」

550:t_1:234.en:
$$アル$$
「The motion manager is subordinate to me, the core unit, but data bus traffic has increased dramatically compared with before.」

550:t_1:235.en:
$$サックス$$
「So you're... starting to feel that the $$レーバテイン$$ is your own body?」

550:t_1:236.en:
$$アル$$
「It is only a hypothesis. If I am gaining bodily awareness, what would happen if wings suddenly grew from my back?」

550:t_1:237.en:
$$サックス$$
「Well... You might start feeling out of sorts.」

550:t_1:238.en:
$$アル$$
「By design, data bus traffic remains within acceptable limits even with the $$ＸＬ－３$$ installed.」

550:t_1:239.en:
$$アル$$
「But if we account for this hard-to-define bodily awareness, the data bus bandwidth may be insufficient.」

550:t_1:241.en:
$$アル$$
「Is it possible to add data bus lines in the time remaining?」

550:t_1:242.en:
$$サックス$$
「I won't say it's impossible. But our current tests show the bandwidth is enough. It has nothing to do with the malfunction.」

550:t_1:243.en:
$$アル$$
「If I am a machine, that is correct.」

550:t_1:244.en:
$$サックス$$
「...I see. I think I understand what you've been trying to say.」

550:t_1:245.en:
$$サックス$$
($$アル$$ is made of liquid-metal components, and he even has that mysterious $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$ system. He isn't just a machine...)

550:t_1:246.en:
$$サックス$$
(Increasing the bandwidth might actually solve it...)

550:t_1:247.en:
$$サックス$$
(But if I add any more, it'll be almost indistinguishable from a human brain.)

550:t_1:249.en:
$$サックス$$
「...We've come this far, so I'll commit to it too. Let's try it...」

550:t_1:251.en:
$$サックス$$
「But we're running out of time. We'll have to rush this, $$ピニオン$$.」

550:t_1:254.en:
$$サックス$$
(Come to think of it, I've known him for a long time now...)
